title: MASTERS ATTP 2024 – the event of the year!
excerpt: An incredible event in the world of table tennis in the Republic of Moldova
body_html:
The most incredible and grandest 🔥 table tennis tournament in the Republic of Moldova, MASTERS ATTP-2024🏓, has come to an end, with 18 masters among the country’s best players taking part.

Thank you to everyone who helped organise and run this unprecedented event, and to everyone who supports Pure and Honest Sport✨.

We send our best wishes and words of gratitude to the leadership of TOP CUP Academy and SETKA-Pro Moldova for their enormous contribution to developing and promoting table tennis in the Republic of Moldova🇲🇩, and for the immeasurable help and care they have shown for several years to hundreds of players and table tennis fans in our country.

Don’t miss the chance to make history❗️
Become part of the biggest table tennis team in Moldova – ATTP ⚡️

We Are the Champions🏆💪
